title: SGLang RCE Exploit Breaches NEAR AI, Steals Data From 18 Agents and About 100 Users

title: Git Patches Flaw That Lets Malicious Repositories Execute Code During Recursive Clones
hint: A flaw in Git can let a malicious repository run an attacker's code on a computer that clones it recursively, together with its submodules. The Git project fixed it this week in Git 2.56.1, with matching fixes for the 2.50 through 2.55 series in 2.50.2, 2.51.3, 2.52.1, 2.53.1, 2.54.1 and 2.55.1.
